So we can call get_flight_cost. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. So we need to output the cost.

Then call get_flight_cost. Then output the cost.

But the user didn't ask to book yet. They said "arrange a flight" but also "check different options". So we can compute cost. Then we can say "estimated total payable amount is X USD".

So let's do that.
